references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, Moses gives a command to kill all male children and women who have had sexual relations with a man, but to spare the virgins alive.
The verse again mentions the number of people (virgins) taken and states how many were given as tribute to the Lord.
Confirms the total number of 32,000 people (virgins) taken as war booty.
The law of warfare that permits taking women and children as war booty from cities outside the land of Canaan.
Rules for taking a woman captive in war and making her your wife.
A similar situation where virgins from Jabesh in Gilead were spared and given to the Benjamites.
